component.name: PowerDeck
component.summary: Switch laptop profiles for work, travel, battery life and maximum performance
Prepínanie profilov notebooku pre prácu, cestovanie, batériu a hranie

description.p: PowerDeck applies profiles of lid, suspend, Wi-Fi powersave and power-mode settings. Every change is shown first, confirmed by you, backed up and can be reverted.

ul.li: Optional: switch profiles without the admin password (powerdeck no-password on), for administrators at the computer only
Packages for Fedora (.rpm) and Arch/Manjaro (PKGBUILD); support for Debian, Fedora, Linux Mint (Cinnamon), Manjaro and Zorin OS
A profile switch keeps the display brightness you had (GNOME sometimes jumped to 50 %); brightness now works without the video group
